units.source_text: 他猛地注意到自己的思考中出了一个重大错误。

en.t: He suddenly realized that there was a serious error in his thinking.

units.source_text: “对于那女人的裸体，解释也太单一化了”。

en.t: His explanation of the woman's nakedness had been far too one-dimensional.

units.source_text: 即使不能说她没有一点儿想引他上钩的心思，

en.t: Even if one could not say she had no intention at all of luring him in,

units.source_text: 也许那说不定，是一种习惯，生活上所必需的、极其平常的习惯吧。

en.t: perhaps it might simply be a habit, an utterly ordinary habit required by daily life.

units.source_text: 女人睡觉肯定是在黎明时分。

en.t: The woman must sleep around dawn.
It is easy to sweat while sleeping.

units.source_text: 白天睡眠，并且是在不断烧烤的沙罐子里，

en.t: Sleeping during the day, and inside a sand jar that was constantly baking,

units.source_text: 裸身自然也就顺理成章了。

en.t: being naked naturally made perfect sense.

units.source_text: 假如自己落在相同条件下，

en.t: If he himself were placed under the same conditions,

units.source_text: 也一定会尽可能赤身露体……

en.t: he too would surely stay as naked as possible...
